paite: TOUPA ka suangpi phat in om hen, ama'n ka khutte galdou azilsak a, ka khutzungte dou ding in achil hi.
heading: David La / Pathian Kiang A Kumpipa Kipahthu Genna
english: By David. Blessed be Yahweh, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

paite: Ka zahngaihna leh ka kulhpi, ka insang leh hon humbitpa, ka phaw leh ka muanna kingakna ka nuai a ka mite zou zelpa ahi.
english: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

paite: TOUPA mihing bang ahia, hichi tel a amah na theih naknak? Mihing tapa leng kua ahia ahih, na ngaihtuah naknak?
english: Yahweh, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

paite: Mihing zaw bangmah lou lel ahi a; adamsung nite lim mang zel bang ahi.
english: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

paite: TOUPA aw, na vante kunsak in hong paisuk inla; tangte khoih in, huchi in akhukhe ding uhi.
english: Part your heavens, Yahweh, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

paite: Khua phesak inla, amau dalhsak in na thalte kapkhia inla, hihbuaigawp in.
english: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

paite: Tunglam a kipan in na khut in hon sawk inla; tui lian a kipan in hon honkhia in.
english: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

paite: Akam un bangmah lou agen ua, akhut taklam uh diklouhna khut taklam ahi.
english: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

paite: Pathian aw, nangmah pahtawi in la thak ka sa ding a; pekging gui sawm nei in nangmah phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

paite: Amah ahi, kumpipate kiang a hotdamna pia a, namsau mi hihse thei lak a asikha David hunkhepa pen.
english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

paite: Hon honkhia inla, mikhualte khut a kipan hon humbit in, akam un thu bangmah lou peuh agen nak ua, akhut taklam uh khut taklam diklou ahi.
english: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

paite: Ka tate uh ahong valnou ua singnou dipdip bang a a-om ua; ka tanute uh leng inpi omdan gel bang a aning a suangkhuak bang a a-om hun un;
english: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

paite: Ka buh innte uh adim a, thil chi chih a-om phetphut a; ka belamte un leng nou asang asang a tam, asing asing a tam ka mun ua aneih chiang un;
english: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

paite: Ka bawngte uh ahong suan phat a; nou neihsiat himhim a-om louh a; insung lok leh pawtkhia a-om louh a, ka kongzingte ua kikou husa a-om louh chiang in.
english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

paite: Huchibang a om mite kipaktak in a-om nak uhi; ahi, TOUPA Pathian anei mite kipaktak in a-om nak uhi.
english: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is Yahweh.
